mapper.select: select r.*, ld.dataset_name as left_dataset_name, rd.dataset_name as right_dataset_name from biz_query_relation r left join biz_query_dataset ld on ld.dataset_id = r.left_dataset_id left join biz_query_dataset rd on rd.dataset_id = r.right_dataset_id where r.query_id = #{queryId} order by r.sort, r.relation_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_query_relation (query_id, left_dataset_id, right_dataset_id, join_type, multi_match, join_keys_json, sort) values (#{queryId}, #{leftDatasetId}, #{rightDatasetId}, coalesce(#{joinType}, 'LEFT'), coalesce(#{multiMatch}, 'EXPAND'), #{joinKeysJson}, coalesce(#{sort}, 0))
mapper.delete: delete from biz_query_relation where left_dataset_id = #{datasetId} or right_dataset_id = #{datasetId}
